action_items: FIX (one-line): In /app/mobile/src/components/tools/ContributionEstimator.tsx pass `voice` into ResultScreen — either add `voice` to its props (change line 228 to `<ResultScreen result={result} form={form} colors={colors} voice={voice} onEdit={...} />` and destructure it in the signature at line 239: `function ResultScreen({ result, form, colors, voice, onEdit }: any)`) OR call `const voice = usePersonaVoice();` at the top of ResultScreen. critical_code_review_comments: ContributionEstimator.tsx: ResultScreen is a JS function *outside* the component but depends on closure-only variable `voice`. This is a straight closure/scope bug — TypeScript/eslint likely didn't catch it because ResultScreen is typed `(...args: any)`. Recommend removing `any` on inner helper components to catch this class of bug at type-check time.

Same file: the govt-share label at line 301 renders `{voice.subjectTitle} {youPct.toFixed(0)}%` — this is the first `voice.*` inside ResultScreen and is what the stack trace points to. Confirms the fix location.

The ce-result outer `<View testID="ce-result">` mounts (per code) *around* ResultScreen — so once ResultScreen throws the whole `ce-result` subtree unmounts and the error-boundary shows the redbox. Adding a per-tool React error boundary would let users retry without a hard crash.

rca of the issue: Root cause: closure scope error. `voice` is declared with `const voice = usePersonaVoice()` at line 44, inside `ContributionEstimator()`. `ResultScreen` is defined at module scope (line 239) as a separate function accepting `(result, form, colors, onEdit)` — it does NOT close over `voice` (it's a peer function, not a nested one). When the JSX at line 228 mounts ResultScreen after submit, every `voice.*` reference at lines 301/304/311/319/320/331/332/367/385/389 evaluates against undefined -> ReferenceError. Repro: login as cathy → /tool/contribution-estimator → click 'See my estimate' with default form values → red-screen. Console: `ReferenceError: voice is not defined at ResultScreen ...ContributionEstimator.tsx:304:155`. Mitigation: pass voice as a prop OR call usePersonaVoice() at the top of ResultScreen.
